entities.summary: Abu Sulayman Muhammad al-Sijistani, nicknamed al-Mantiqi, c. 912 – c. 985 CE, named for his origins in the Sijistan or Sistan region in present-day Eastern Iran and Southern Afghanistan, was a leading Islamic humanist philosopher in Baghdad.
